title: C001 occurrence-01 failure profile by code and per family
final_text:
Everything is complete and verified. Final state:

**What I built**

- `check/c001_profile.py` — the aggregation script. It walks all 240 receipts with `Path.rglob`, derives the slug→family mapping at runtime from `src/minireason/data/endpoints.json` (slug = registry `name` with `/`→`-`), asserts count/coordinate/slug sanity, aggregates both code-bearing fields together with their field provenance, and writes the report.
- `check/check_c001_profile.py` — an independent verification script (own aggregation pass, no shared code) that recomputes every aggregate and asserts the corresponding rows appear in the markdown.
- `out/c001-profile.md` — the failure profile, containing: the derived endpoint→family mapping; (1) the code census over all 240 receipts with co-carriage (both/one/neither); (2) per-family counts with receipts per family; (3) per-family-and-arm counts; (4) the status distribution per endpoint; (5) a 20-row list of every coded receipt with coordinate, codes, `finish_reason` and `usage.completion_tokens`; (6) a concentration section naming endpoint and recorded ceiling, with no rates, shares or rankings; (7) a "what the records do not settle" section.

**Key findings (counts, produced by `python3 check/c001_profile.py`)**
- 240 receipts; codes: `INCOMPLETE_GENERATION` (`failure_type`, provider-side) = 20 receipts; `NO_PUBLIC_CONTENT` (`validation_failure_type`, validation-side) = 11 receipts; co-carriage: both = 11, provider-only = 9, validation-only = 0, neither = 220.
- Per family: `deepseek` 19 coded of 40 (both-fields 11), `ollama-cloud/glm` 1 of 40; all other families 0. All 20 coded receipts are arm `fcl`; 0 of 120 in `prose`.
- Status per endpoint: `deepseek-flash` 21 COMPLETE / 8 PARTIAL / 11 FAILED; `ollama-glm-5.3` 39/1/0; the other four endpoints 40/0/0.
- Concentration: `INCOMPLETE_GENERATION` sits on `deepseek-flash` (19 of 20), all `fcl`, with every reporting receipt stopped at `finish_reason=length`, `completion_tokens=8192` under the receipt-quoted 8,192-token ceiling (a resource boundary, stated as such); the remaining coded receipt is `ollama-glm-5.3/fcl/control/rep2` at 32,768 tokens.
- Unsettled items explicitly named in section 7: null finish/usage on the 11 FAILED receipts, the 32,768-vs-8,192 ceiling mismatch on the glm receipt, null provider fields on FAILED receipts, and the cause of exact co-occurrence of the two codes.

**Verification**: `python3 check/c001_profile.py` exits 0 and `python3 check/check_c001_profile.py` exits 0 with all assertions passed (recomputed 240 / both=11 / only-ft=9 / neither=220, 20 coded rows confirmed independently, spot-checked markdown rows). No rates, shares, rankings or reliability claims between families, arms or endpoints appear anywhere in the output.
